mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 4%, it signals strong demand that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as companies ramp up production to meet demand.
failure_condition: INDPRO YoY change exceeds 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative >50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4%, it signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as companies face higher costs.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls below 4% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive >50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both show year-over-year declines of more than 5%, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both show YoY declines >5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month, and payroll employment (PAYEMS) also declines, it signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises >0.5pp MoM and PAYEMS declines, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive >50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) both rise by more than 1% year-over-year, it signals a combination of strong demand and tightening monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO and FEDFUNDS both rise >1% YoY but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 0.5% month-over-month, and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is already above 4%, it signals an inflationary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed is forced to tighten policy further.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises >0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive >50% of the time.
